title: emir error
description: What every command prints in --format json when it cannot do its job. `code` is the registry code (`emir explain`); the exit status is `exit_code`.

shell.description: present (true) when the command is not an emir command (ls, tail, klayout ...): it needs a shell, which the MCP server does not have (emir_cli refuses it with EMIR-E591)

needs_human.description: present (true) when the step leads to a run the person decides on (it re-simulates, or runs a licensed tool): ask them first

items.description: Exact commands to run next, in order; each runs as printed. An emir command keeps the caller's --format, except a run's `emir report` step (its Markdown is what to relay).
